from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper with its title and references to other papers in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title, as written")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
